why: The small circle moves one corner clockwise each step: top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, top-left. So in the 5th figure it is back at the top-right corner. Only option 4 has the circle at the top-right, so the book picks option 4. Options 1, 2 and 3 have the circle at the bottom-right.
trick: When several things move, find the rule that is certain first (here the circle) and use it to remove options.
note: Following the cross (BR, TR, TL, BL) it should come back to BR, so the cross in D (bottom-left) does not fit perfectly; D is the only option with the circle in the right corner.
